meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (French-influenced Civil Law with Islamic Sharia principles limited to personal status matters; commercial and corporate law governed by secular civil law statutes)

Investment Protection Treaty between Egypt and the United Kingdom (signed 1975; retained post-Brexit under UK rollover investment agreement)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 concerning Combating of Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism, as amended by Law No. 8 of 2015, together with its executive regulations; Law No. 194 of 2020 regarding the Central Bank and the Banking Sector and its AML/CFT rules; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (including Articles 20-22 on incorporation filings and beneficial ownership identification) and its Executive Regulations; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended) and applicable GAFI Commercial Registry beneficial-owner declaration forms.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized companies registry or commercial court in the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization (Egyptian Consulate in the country of origin and Legalization Department of the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Jurisdiction of origin's official trade register / registry authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization (Egyptian Consulate in the country of origin and Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized board resolution authorizing incorporation of the Egyptian LLC, appointment of the local incorporation agent, and approval of the draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign corporate shareholder (notarized in the overseas jurisdiction)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization (if required by GAFI; apostille is not accepted for Egypt as Egypt is not a Hague Apostille Convention party)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney in favor of the local Egyptian establishment agent or resident manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign shareholder or ultimate owner (notarized abroad)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization (Egyptian Consular office and then Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport or national identity copies of all shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and the designated manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notarial authority or issuing state authority in the holder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy plus certified Arabic translation (translation certified by Egyptian Ministry of Justice-affiliated translator); consular legalization required for foreign notarizations where no apostille is recognized

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP and sanctions screening under Law No. 80 of 2002 and the Egyptian Money Laundering Combating Unit (EMLCU) guidelines. Before incorporation the notary/GAFI filing must include a negative anti-money laundering declaration. The formation agent and bank must screen all shareholders, directors, UBOs and authorized signatories against the EMLCU consolidated watchlist, UN Security Council sanctions consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, UK HM Treasury sanctions, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, CBE sanctions circulars, and domestic Egyptian sanctions notices. Any match, adverse media, or politically exposed person (PEP) status triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification. For this low-risk dehydrated vegetables/spices wholesale export activity, PEP screening is still mandatory at onboarding and should occur at least every 12 months thereafter, or upon any ownership change.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – online Company Name Reservation portal (https://www.investinegypt.gov.eg) together with the GAFI Commercial Registry electronic services platform.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Every Egyptian LLC must select its corporate name in Arabic script; the Arabic name is the authoritative registered name. A non-Arabic (e.g., English) commercial name may be added in roman script, but it must be a transliteration or translation of the Arabic name and must be reflected in the Articles of Association. Arabic names must be distinctive, neutral, not misleading, and not identical or confusingly similar to any existing GAFI-registered entity or to a nationally protected trademark. Foreign elements are transliterated phonetically into Arabic using standard Egyptian transliteration conventions.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If GAFI rejects or delays a name reservation, the applicant may, within fifteen (15) business days of written notification, submit an administrative appeal addressed to the Chairman of the GAFI Legalization and Grievance Committee through the electronic grievance module. The appeal must include: (1) the original name-clearance receipt and rejection notice; (2) a legal memorandum explaining compliance with Arabic naming rules and distinctiveness; (3) supporting evidence of existing trademark or good-will entitlement, if applicable; and (4) two alternate proposed names. GAFI must issue a prima facie decision within fifteen (15) working days. An unsuccessful appeal can be escalated to the Minister of Investment's Ombudsman/Grievance Unit no later than thirty (30) days from the GAFI final rejection, followed by appeal to the Egyptian Council of State (administrative court) under the Egyptian Administrative Procedures Law.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partial acceptance for a low-risk trading/distribution business. GAFI accepts a serviced office or a collaborative workspace address as the registered office only where a physical mailbox, an Egyptian resident administrative manager, and a dedicated local contact are available. Purely digital virtual addresses with no physical presence and no resident manager are not permitted. For this dehydrated spices exporter, a physical commercial location in an Egyptian free zone or an ordinary commercial district is recommended to satisfy registration, tax-card and banking KYC requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated annual probability between 5% and 10%. Formation-stage inspections are rare; the probability increases moderately if the company registers inconsistent address details, fails to file tax returns, or shows atypical trade flows. Unannounced on-site inspections may be conducted by GAFI, the Tax Authority, or the Commercial Registry, but for a low-risk wholesale export activity the likelihood remains in the 'low' tier.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018 and Law No. 194 of 2020, Articles 1, 6, 21-34 (Limited Liability Company formation, quota capital and management organs); Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976; Ministerial Decree No. 1789 of 2020 (GAFI incorporation procedure); Executive Regulations of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 for non-free-zone projects.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Companies Registration Directorate and Commercial Registry, Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade, Cairo (One-Stop Shop issuance point).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Ta'sis wa Layihat Ta'sis) authenticated before a Notary Public, submitted electronically through the GAFI One-Stop Shop (Invest Egypt e-platform).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs after the 2018 amendments; the quota capital must be fixed in the Incorporation Contract, fully subscribed and paid in cash or in kind before or upon incorporation. Cash quotas must be deposited into a temporary formation account at an Egyptian licensed bank and evidenced by a bank capital deposit certificate. No statutory escrow account is mandated; funds are released to the operating account upon Commercial Registry issuance.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED at the First Board Meeting of [LLC_NAME], an Egyptian Limited Liability Company: (1) The notarized Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association ratified by the founding members are approved and adopted; (2) the subscribed paid-in capital quotas allocated to each founding member are acknowledged and the supporting bank certificate is accepted; (3) the registered office is fixed at Cairo, Egypt; (4) the founding officers — Chairman, Managing Director, and Compliance Secretary — are appointed with joint-signatory authority to open bank accounts, execute export and purchase agreements, apply for tax and export licenses, and complete social insurance filings; and (5) all lawful ancillary actions necessary to formalize the company's existence are ratified. Adopted unanimously and recorded.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Activity Description Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop — Name Reservation Unit (Cairo Headquarters; online via Invest Egypt portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the single-page name reservation request with the proposed English/Arabic name and two fallback alternatives, attaching the description of the ISIC 4638 dehydrated spices trading scope. GAFI cross-checks the Commercial Registry database, registered trademarks, and local court name records; the cleared name is reserved for 60 days.
required_dossiers: GAFI name reservation application form
Certified passport copies of all founding members
Notarized power of attorney for the local signatory (for non-resident founders)
Project description covering HS 0712 (dehydrated vegetables) and HS 0904 (crushed chili) export activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or imprecise scope, immediately re-file a corrected set of names using the same application reference; a reasoned objection may be submitted to the GAFI Legal Affairs Directorate within 10 working days of the rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Verification and Paid-up Capital Deposit Arrangement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any Egyptian licensed commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr) corporate branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open an unregistered formation account in the projected company name using the GAFI name reservation receipt and a draft incorporation contract; deposit the aggregate subscribed cash capital, segregate each founding member's quota, and obtain a bank capital deposit certificate identifying member names, paid-in quota amounts, and the account. The certificate is a prerequisite for notarization and GAFI registration.
required_dossiers: Bank corporate account application for formation deposit
GAFI name reservation receipt
Draft incorporation contract and capital schedule
Founder identities and beneficial ownership statement
Source-of-funds declaration for the deposited quotas
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires a tax ID for opening the deposit account, rely on Central Bank of Egypt formation-account guidance and the GAFI clearance receipt; if the bank still refuses, select an alternate CBE-approved bank and submit a notarized undertaking from founders that the funds are irrevocably dedicated to the LLC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Incorporation Contract before the Public Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office, Ministry of Justice (Cairo notarial district)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founding members, or their duly appointed power-of-attorney holders, must appear in person and sign the final Arabic incorporation contract. The notary reads the clauses on company name, object, capital, quota values, managers, and registered office, verifies the identification documents and the capital deposit certificate, then authenticates and registers the contract in the public notary register.
required_dossiers: Final bilingual incorporation contract and articles of association
Bank capital deposit certificate
Original national IDs/passports or valid powers of attorney
Lease or title evidence of the intended registered office
Stamp duty payment receipts for the notarization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary suspends authentication for missing or inconsistent documents (e.g., spelling differences), make the required corrections and request a new notarial session; any substantial amendment to capital quotas requires a revised bank certificate before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing, Commercial Registry Entry, and Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop — Companies Registration Directorate (application through the Invest Egypt single window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit electronically the notarized contract, capital certificate, registered-office lease, KYC declarations, and officer appointments to the GAFI One-Stop Shop. After legal formality review and fee settlement, GAFI issues the company incorporation decision, assigns the Commercial Registry Number, and orders publication of the incorporation summary in a state-authorized gazette.
required_dossiers: Notarized incorporation contract and articles (original)
Bank capital payment certificate
Notarized office lease or title deed with zoning conformity
First Board Resolution appointing officers and adopting the registered address
GAFI electronic registration form and fee payment receipt
KYC and beneficial ownership schedule of quota holders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is queried by the One-Stop Shop for lease zoning or quota discrepancies, cure the objection within 10 working days through the same reference number; a contested refusal can be appealed before the GAFI Grievance Committee with the legal formality opinion.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Issuance of the Tax Identification Number and Tax Card
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Taxation (GAT) — Head Office and competent district tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the tax registration form together with the incorporation decision and commercial registry certificate. GAT assigns the tax identification number and issues the official tax card, and registers the LLC for corporate income tax and stamp taxes. The export-oriented LLC must also confirm the VAT registration treatment of foreign zero-rated supplies.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation decision
Commercial registry certificate
Registered office lease and board resolution
Copy of the managing director's national ID
Stamp duty payment receipts
Board resolution on authorized tax representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAT fails to issue the tax card within the statutory 5-day review window, submit a follow-up with a copy of the completed filing to the local tax office head; unresolved delay is elevated to GAT's central complaint unit for immediate release.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance Registration as Employer at NOSI
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) — employment registration service, Ministry of Manpower
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the LLC as an employer at the NOSI office in the company's headquarters district; provide the payroll schedule and officer employment status to obtain the employer social insurance file number. Directors serving as managers are also registered for mandatory insurance cover.
required_dossiers: NOSI employer registration application form
Commercial registry certificate
Tax identification card
Approved payroll plan and employment contracts (officers)
Identity documents of all directors and initial employees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI rejects the file upon a name mismatch with the commercial registry, deliver an updated commercial certificate first and then re-register; no additional state fee applies to a remedial submission in the same month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) — Foreign Trade Registration Office, Ministry of Trade and Industry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for inclusion in the importer/exporter register with the activity description 'wholesale trade of dehydrated spices and vegetable products (ISIC 4638, HS 0712, HS 0904)'. GOEIC issues an exporter card and facility code, records authorized signatories for certificates of origin, and verifies that the premises meet sanitary trading rules before the first export declaration.
required_dossiers: GOEIC importer/exporter registration form
Commercial registry certificate
Tax card
Product tariff classification sheet (HS 0712 / HS 0904) and laboratory analysis of the chili and garlic product
Board resolution designating export signatories
Warehouse sanitary conformity statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GOEIC raises tariff classification or origin issues, provide supporting goods descriptors and a prior binding tariff ruling from the Customs Authority; any rejection is appealable to the GOEIC Registration Committee within 15 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Activation of Operational Bank Account and Trade Finance Rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank — corporate banking department, Central Bank of Egypt compliance regime
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the full corporate KYC file, present the incorporation and tax documentation, and execute the bank's account agreement with the two-signature mandate from the board resolution (chairman/signatory and compliance secretary). The operational account activates SWIFT incoming letters of credit and telegraphic transfer rails aligned with the export clients' issuing banks.
required_dossiers: Completed corporate account opening forms and KYC dossier
Board resolution on authorized signatories with specimen signatures
Commercial registry and tax card certificates
GOEIC exporter registration certificate
Beneficial ownership declaration and quota-holder list
Draft SWIFT LC/TT operational instructions to the bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank compliance demands additional source-of-funds documentation, provide notarized quota transfer documents and the capital deposit certificate; an unreasonable block is referred by the company to the Central Bank of Egypt corporate banking compliance unit with a formal complaint track.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: GAFI Industrial Licensing Center and Industrial Development Authority (IDA), Ministry of Trade and Industry — mandatory only if the LLC commences onsite sieving, blending, or repacking; otherwise municipal food premises registration with the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) and GOEIC registration are the operative controls.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Premises and Warehouse Registration Certificate (NFSA) together with GOEIC Exporter Registration; the broad-scope Industrial Operating License (IDA) is not mandatory for pure wholesale trading of sealed bulk dehydrated spices until physical processing is introduced.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment, Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 'C' Simple Environmental Registration (low-risk warehousing and trading in an enclosed, clean operation); no full EIA report is mandated for trading and ambient dry storage of dehydrated garlic and chili. A full Category A/B assessment becomes mandatory only if grinding, oil extraction, or wastewater-intensive processing is added.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Dust and particulate limits for dry spice handling: ambient PM10 not exceeding 150 microg/m3 on a 24-hour Egyptian AAQS basis; sealed waste management applicable; any wash-down wastewater must satisfy Law No. 93 of 1962 discharge rules (pH 6.5-8.5, BOD less than or equal to 25 mg/L, TSS less than or equal to 30 mg/L, oil and grease less than or equal to 5 mg/L); spice refuse must be segregated and collected by a licensed municipal waste contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Civil Defense Directorate (Ministry of Interior) with tested extinguishers, evacuation maps, and flame-retardant lining of the warehouse; Ministry of Manpower labor inspectorate clearance for occupational health (dust masks, gloves, ventilation over open weighing stations, and first-aid kits); Ministry of Health food-handler certificates for warehouse employees handling export lots; and NFSA periodic hygiene inspection compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance, Arab Republic of Egypt; official unified taxpayer portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing and e-receipt clearance platform: https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg; principal offices at Ramses Street, Nasr City, Cairo.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Within 30 days of commercial registration, the LLC files the unified registration application through the ETA portal or the jurisdictional tax center. The dossier must include: certified Arabic translation of the incorporation contract and articles of association, commercial register extract (CR number), notarized board resolution and power of attorney, office lease or title deed, identification documents of managers and shareholders, and GAFI investment license documents where applicable. The ETA issues a 13-digit unified TIN evidenced by the tax card covering income tax, VAT, and withholding tax files simultaneously. Exporters must complete VAT registration regardless of turnover, because a valid VAT/TIN file is a precondition for export declaration, zero-rating, and input VAT refund. Lead time for card issuance is 15-30 working days; a temporary registration number is issued for invoicing during processing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - The Egyptian LLC is a resident juridical person under Articles 12-14 of Law 91/2005, taxed on worldwide profits at the 22.5% corporate income tax rate. The LLC is fully non-transparent: no pass-through is available even for 100% foreign-owned LLCs; distributed dividends are subject to the 10% dividend withholding tax unless a treaty reduction applies; capital gains from asset disposals are taxed at the corporate rate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not provide check-the-box or entity-classification elections; the LLC is mandatorily taxed at entity level. The available statutory elections are as follows: (1) small and medium enterprise simplified presumptive tax regime under Law 152/2020, which may be elected by companies with gross turnover not exceeding EGP 20 million and which replaces the standard 22.5% corporate income tax with sector-based presumptive brackets; (2) depreciation and amortization method elections within ETA-approved schedules under Articles 25-26 of Law 91/2005; (3) foreign tax credit election for foreign-source income under ratified tax treaties; (4) election to carry assessed losses forward for five years, with no carryback; (5) no national tax group consolidation applies to a standalone LLC. Hybrid mismatch rules and CFC rules have not been enacted in Egypt.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) - Law No. 67 of 2016 and Executive Regulations Decree No. 66 of 2017, administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 - mandatory VAT registration when the annual value of taxable supplies exceeds EGP 500,000; voluntary registration is available above EGP 150,000; exporters of goods are mandatorily registrable regardless of turnover because a valid VAT/TIN file is a precondition for export declaration, zero-rating, and input VAT refund.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing (E-Invoice) and e-receipts (E-Receipt/POS) pursuant to ETA Decision No. 68 of 2020 and successive phase-in decrees. Every VAT registrant must integrate its billing or ERP system with the ETA Central Clearing Platform through a certified application-to-application API using XML/JSON payloads signed with an e-token digital signature. The ETA clears each invoice near-real-time, returns a unique clearing ID, and affixes an electronic stamp (QR code). Invoices not cleared by the ETA are treated as non-issued for deduction, refund, and customs purposes. Paper or manual substitution is prohibited for VAT-registered businesses. Non-integrated exporters are blocked from customs export processing and lose refund eligibility. Bulk sales to resellers remain subject to the same clearance and must carry the same electronic data set covering seller, buyer, item codes, VAT amounts, and export or import flags.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Article 29(1) of Law 67/2016 zero-rates tangible goods physically exported outside Egypt. The LLC must demonstrate: (a) conclusion of the sale with a non-resident buyer under a written contract; (b) actual export through an Egyptian Customs port evidenced by a stamped Customs Export Declaration with exit confirmation; (c) compliance with statutory e-invoicing clearance for the export invoice; (d) receipt of the foreign-currency export proceeds through a licensed Egyptian bank with an Inward Remittance Certificate; and (e) production of the full documentation bundle on request. Dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper shipments must also satisfy food export and health certification conditions where the importing country requires them. The correlated input VAT on raw materials, packaging, and logistics is offset against output VAT, and the resulting excess claim is refunded by the ETA within the statutory refund cycle after desk audit. If export is not completed within the regulatory completion period, the supply reverts to standard-rated 14% VAT and the refund is clawed back.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan Khuruji) stamped by the Egyptian Customs Authority with port and exit confirmation and declaration number cross-referenced to the cleared e-invoice
Original negotiable Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing shipment of the dehydrated vegetable and spice cargo to the non-resident buyer's destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by an Egyptian licensed bank evidencing receipt of convertible foreign-currency proceeds within the FX repatriation deadline
Commercial invoice and packing list stating HS classification, quantities, unit values, and ISIC 4638 trade description for dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper
Signed international sale contract or purchase order evidencing the export terms, incoterms, and transfer of title and risk to the non-resident buyer
Export registration certificate from the exporters' registry and applicable phytosanitary or health certificates for food consignments
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA reconciles cleared e-invoices, Customs export declarations, and bank IRC records through a unified digital matching system. Any export zero-rating claim that fails the documentary, exit, or FX-repatriation test is reversed and assessed as standard-rated output VAT at 14% from the original invoice date, plus a late-payment delinquency fine of 3% per month of the unpaid tax, capped at 60% of the tax. Where refunds have already been paid, the ETA claws back the refund with these penalties and interest. Fraudulent customs declarations, forged IRCs, or sham offshore buyers trigger criminal evasion prosecution under Article 45 of Law 67/2016 with imprisonment and a fine of not less than double the evaded tax, suspension of e-invoicing privileges, and blocking of future export clearances. The general assessment limitation period is five years from the due date of the declaration, extended without limit in instances of fraud or intentional concealment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a managed floating exchange rate regime under Central Bank of Egypt supervision. Current account transactions enjoy high convertibility subject to mandatory CBE reporting and documentation. Capital account transactions including profit repatriation and capital transfers require prior CBE approval and are subject to quantitative restrictions. Profit remittance for non-resident investors is permitted after 20 percent withholding tax deduction and compliance with repatriation procedures.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must surrender 100 percent of foreign exchange export proceeds to authorized banks within 90 days of shipment date. Mandatory conversion into Egyptian pounds occurs at the official CBE rate or prevailing interbank rate. Non-compliance triggers administrative penalties, account restrictions, and potential suspension of export licenses.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Cross-border electronic money institution operations face strict CBE licensing and AML oversight. Offshore digital EMIs are permitted only through licensed Egyptian subsidiaries or partnerships, imposing significant legal constraints on direct cross-border digital payment rails without local regulatory compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and authorized signatories must appear physically for initial KYC interviews and account opening. Remote video KYC is generally not permitted for new corporate accounts but may be considered for existing clients with established relationships.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ultimate beneficial owner declaration form, corporate ownership chart, passport copies, and source of wealth evidence

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign bank statements, tax clearance certificates, GAFI investment approval, and third-party verification letters

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and politically exposed persons screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full compliance screening reports, mitigation measures, and ongoing monitoring documentation

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections are processed via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 with purpose codes including Equity Capital Contribution or Investment in Egyptian LLC. All transactions require CBE prior approval for foreign direct investment, supporting documentation including investment license, and full AML verification including source of funds checks.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements utilize SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers and issuance of commercial letters of credit under UCP 600. All disbursements must be supported by export documentation and comply with CBE export proceeds surrender requirements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial registration annual renewal (legal entity registry certificate)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade (submitted through GAFI One-Stop Shop)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during 1 January through 28/29 February (calendar-year renewal window)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal is penalized under Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976; continued non-renewal results in registry suspension, administrative strike-off, and loss of legal capacity to trade.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and advance payment reconciliation, accompanied by audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - electronic filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after fiscal year-end; calendar-year taxpayers must file by April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing and late-payment penalties under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005; additional tax accrues at 2% per month on unpaid tax, with enforced collection and director liability upon continued default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of audited annual financial statements and annual report with the companies registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after approval by the quotaholders' general assembly; assembly must be convened within six months of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit exposes the LLC to GAFI enforcement proceedings; repeated default may trigger administrative strike-off and the auditor's qualified opinion is not accepted as a substitute.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual quotaholders' general assembly minutes and statutory register updates
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company statutory records at registered office; authenticated or notarized minutes where Egyptian law or practice requires
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: General assembly for approval of accounts annually within six months of fiscal year-end; minute book and registers updated without undue delay thereafter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Neglect may invalidate profit distributions, expose managers to civil liability under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, and impair the statutory register audit report.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of quotaholder and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI / Commercial Registry - legal entity data file and AML registration system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with commercial registry annual renewal (1 January through 28/29 February) and within 30 days of any quota share transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or stale UBO data is punishable under Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2016; unregistered quota transfers are unenforceable against the company and its creditors.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian LLCs are subject to an annual mandatory independent audit; no revenue, asset, or shareholder-count de minimis exemption exists under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), issued by the Ministry of Finance and substantially converged with IFRS; applicable alongside the ETA tax accounting records requirements; books and supporting documents must be retained for a minimum of five years.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Egypt does not impose a stand-alone annual UBO confirmation form for LLCs; quotaholder and UBO ownership data (25% or greater voting/quota ownership, or controlling influence) must be factual and current in the commercial register legal-entity file, re-verified at each annual renewal window, and updated within 30 days of any quota share transfer; transfers become enforceable against the company only upon registration in the quotaholders' register.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400-1,200 per year (Cairo registered office and correspondence agent)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 800-2,500 per year (small to medium trading LLC)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Free zone incentives (0% CIT for 10-15 years), accelerated depreciation, R&D tax credits

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) Annual Tax Return Form via e-Filing Portal (e-Tax)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months following the end of the fiscal year (31 December for calendar year taxpayers)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report only Egyptian source income; adjust for permanent establishment
Limited to allowable deductions under Egyptian law

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of EGP 500 per day up to EGP 5,000, plus 1% monthly surcharge on unpaid tax, criminal prosecution possible

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from Egyptian Tax Authority, submit to withholding agent with DTA application form
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 10% statutory, reduced under DTAs (e.g. 0-5% for certain); Interest: 15% statutory, reduced under DTAs (e.g. 0-10%)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 500,000 (approx. USD 16,000) for related party transactions triggering Local File and Master File requirements
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) require adequate economic substance for tax benefits; applicable to holding, IP, and trading activities

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income or false declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties including fines up to 100% of evaded tax and imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, disqualification from office, civil restitution orders

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a company without real business operations or substance in Egypt
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution, fines up to EGP 1 million, loss of tax incentives
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for damages, possible travel bans and asset freezes

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain TP documentation or apply arm's length principle
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 100% of underpaid tax, interest charges, potential double taxation adjustments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several liability for tax due, reputational damage
